items.question: In what manner will the nature of the outcaste woman be declared to the goddess?
premises: The speaker promises to declare the subject of the outcaste woman.
The goddess is directly addressed and asked to listen.
The explanation is to be given as it truly is.
items.inference: The speaker commits to giving the goddess a faithful and direct account of the outcaste woman.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal content of 'antyajā' depends on the preceding and following context.
items.plain_english: O goddess, listen: I shall declare the outcaste woman as she truly is.
